market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,400; $1,500 requires ~37.5% drawdown by Dec 31. ETH historical 7+ month max drawdowns this size occur in ~25-30% of intervals. ETH has lagged BTC and is more volatile than BTC, so somewhat higher base rate than BTC at similar drawdown.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Long horizon and ETH-specific risks (L2 fragmentation, regulatory).
